parsed.name: 罗德与施瓦茨 RTO1024 示波器
parsed.description: 一台数字示波器，用于实验中的时域信号采集与波形读取。根据驱动证据，该设备可配置采样率、触发相关的采集时间窗口，并读取通道 1 的波形数据。
parsed.description_en: A digital oscilloscope used for time-domain signal acquisition and waveform readout in laboratory experiments. Based on the driver evidence, it can configure sampling rate and trigger-related acquisition windows, and read waveform data from channel 1.

actions.description: 配置示波器测量准备参数，如采样率、触发相关的波形导出起始/结束时间等。
actions.description_en: Configure oscilloscope measurement settings such as sampling rate and trigger-related waveform export start/stop times.

actions.description: 执行一次波形采集并读取通道 1 的时域轨迹数据。
actions.description_en: Perform a waveform acquisition and read out the time-domain trace data from channel 1.
